title: Sunday · the corn, the last
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The corn as a Sunday for the second time: the tray on the long table, #1 above, and, new since 2007, the pup's bed below and the boxes along the wall. Twenty-three. The last public Sunday of it.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the drafting table from above: corn, a mug, a brush, the yellowed first strip on the wall at the top edge — and at the bottom edge, the pup's ear in the bed below.

characters.pose: an ear at the bottom edge

panels.composition: Tier 2: the corn, close, in the same watercolor as 2007. The butter. The salt. Twenty-three trays.

panels.composition: Tier 3: the wall along the garage: the boxes, twenty of them now, numbered on their lids, the light on them. Held.
